results.title: AI Benchmarks and Datasets for LLM Evaluation
results.content: # AI Benchmarks and Datasets for LLM Evaluation. In the age of Artificial Intelligence, large language models (LLMs) have become the preferred tool for many everyday tasks. The enactment of the EU AI Act [6] by the European Parliament on March 13, 2024, establishing the first comprehensive EU-wide requirements for the development, deployment, and use of AI systems, further underscores the importance of tools and methodologies such as Z-Inspection. This open-source, compliance-centered evaluation framework for generative AI models provides the first comprehensive technical interpretation of the EU AI Act [6] in the context of LLMs. By proposing the first LLM benchmarking suite based on the EU requirements for Trustworthy AI [7], COMPL-AI highlights the significant gap in LLM compliance. The remainder of the paper elaborates on Z-Inspection, the EU AI Act, and the COMPL-AI framework, followed by a comprehensive list of AI benchmarks and dataset summaries.
